name: shared-file-guard
description: Refuses a shell write to a shared file (STATUS.md, CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, or the files you name) that this session has not read, or that another session changed since

watched_files.title: Files to watch
watched_files.description: Comma separated file names that several sessions share; * matches any run of name characters (such as *register*.md). Empty means STATUS.md, CLAUDE.md and MEMORY.md.
